answer:
Start the container with the `--gpus=all` flag:

"docker run -d --gpus=all -v ollama:/root/.ollama -p 11434:11434 --name ollama ollama/ollama" [ollama/docs/docker.md]

Before running this, the NVIDIA Container Toolkit must be installed, and Docker must be configured to use the NVIDIA driver. The docs say: "sudo nvidia-ctk runtime configure --runtime=docker" followed by "sudo systemctl restart docker" [ollama/docs/docker.md].

If the container can't see your GPU, the troubleshooting guide suggests running "docker run --gpus all ubuntu nvidia-smi" to confirm the container runtime works [ollama/docs/troubleshooting.md].
